feature_spec.title: GLM tool_plan Run System integration
acceptance_criteria: tool_plan execution produces an explicit execution verdict
4OSS advisory packet is prepared from the same run context
manual-bb and QEG evidence can distinguish design readiness from implementation completion
tool_plan-applied dev results require acceptance gate context before integration
rework loop attempts are bounded and blocked after the configured maximum
assumptions: External 4OSS CLI invocation remains advisory until a connector adapter is implemented
Production default can enable bounded local tool_plan execution only with the Shipyard acceptance gate active

observation_set.summary: Local path validation and limited tool_plan execution are covered by tests.
Run System packet maps worker result metadata to 4OSS inputs.
dry-run, allowed paths, change limits, diff artifact persistence, exact-once patch intent, and execution verdict are implemented in the local executor.
test failure summarizer, rework prompt context, bounded rework guard, acceptance gate context, and acceptance enforcement audit are implemented.

risk_register.summary: dry-run, diff artifact, allowed path, file limit, size limit, and execution verdict controls are implemented.
tool-plan.json, execution-verdict.json, diff-stat.txt, diff.patch, and test-summary.json are saved under artifacts/jobs/<job_id>/ for non-dry-run executions.
tool_plan-applied dev results store acceptance_gate_context and acceptance stage emits run.acceptanceGateEnforced.
The test failure summarizer is carried into the next dev prompt, and bounded rework attempts block after the maximum.

gate_decision.reason: Core execution safety controls, acceptance gate context, bounded rework guard, RunSystemPacket, manual-bb evidence, and QEG fixture are implemented for the standard profile.
